title: Federal Public Service Commission Amendment Act 2004

sections.shortTitle: Federal Public Service Commission Amendment Act 2004
sections.description:
Short Title and Commencement

ACT XI OF 2004
ACT XI OF 2004
FEDERAL PUBLIC
SERVICE COMMISSION (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2004
An Act further to
amend the Federal Public Service Commission Ordinance, 1977
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 16th December, 2004]
The following Act of Majilis‑e‑Shoora
(Parliament) received the assent of the President on 8th December, 2004, is
hereby published for general information:‑‑
Whereas it is expedient further
to amend the Federal Public Service Commission Ordinance, 1977 (XLV of 1977),
for the purpose hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby enacted as follows:‑‑
1. Short title and
commencement.‑‑‑(1) This Act may be called the Federal
Public Service Commission (Amendment) Act, 2004.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

The following Act of Majilis‑e‑Shoora
(Parliament) received the assent of the President on 8th December, 2004, is
hereby published for general information:‑‑
Whereas it is expedient further
to amend the Federal Public Service Commission Ordinance, 1977 (XLV of 1977),
for the purpose hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby enacted as follows:‑‑
2. Amendment of section 7,
Ordinance XLV of 1977.‑‑‑In the Federal Public Service
Commission Ordinance, 1977 (XLV of 1977), in section 7, in subsection (2),
after clause (i), the following new clause shall be inserted, namely:‑‑
"(ia) in
the Directorate General of Inter Services Intelligence (ISI)."
